title: Translate With Care: Addressing Gender Bias, Neutrality, and Reasoning in Large Language Model Translations

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution and ratio of gendered pronouns (e.g., he vs. she) generated by machine translation models when translating ambiguous sentences from genderless languages into English, specifically comparing how models default to certain pronouns in contexts containing gender stereotypes like leadership, professional success, and physical strength.
